import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
df['촉매로트_그룹'] = df['촉매로트'].apply(lambda x: 'old' if x in ['FC-2602', 'FC-2603', 'FC-2604', 'FC-2605'] else 'new')
bins = np.arange(2.5, 6.75 + 0.25, 0.25)
df['bin_idx'] = pd.cut(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins=bins, right=False, labels=False)
grouped = df.groupby(['촉매로트_그룹', 'bin_idx']).agg(
    CNT수율_mean=('CNT수율 (g/g-cat)', 'mean'),
    n=('런ID', 'count')
).reset_index()
grouped['체류시간_bin_mid'] = grouped['bin_idx'].map(lambda i: bins[int(i)] + 0.125)
df = grouped.drop(columns=['bin_idx'])
